create_manipulator_robot: create a Manipulator instance with URDF path, simulator, and joint configuration parameters
reconfigure_manipulator_joints: reconfigure the manipulator robot by loading URDF, setting joint motors, and initializing arm and gripper states
set_gripper_target_state: set the gripper motors to a desired symmetric state between open and closed positions
calculate_ee_forward_kinematics: calculate the end-effector position for a given joint state using forward kinematics
interpolate_arm_control: interpolate arm joint movements over time with smooth transitions between current and target positions
